text:
infra-alert-bot: :rotating_light: autoscaler error detected in eu-central-01 GPU pool, allocation queue growing > 1200. Scaling requests stuck pending due to 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED' from cloud provider. Auto-retry backoff in progress.
Marta: ack. I'm oncall. Anyone seen this pattern where quota propagation lags but billing/quotas show pool has free headroom?
Devon: looking now. IIUC the autoscaler requested N additional nodes ~ 10m ago and cloud returned 403/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for the create calls. Console shows GPUs at hard limit for project.
Li: Confirming GCP reports "GPU_QUOTA_REACHED" for zone europe-central1-b. No recent quota edits. We hit a rapid burst from a big batch rerun earlier this morning.
Marta: customer impact? Jordan, can you surface error rates and top affected customers?
Jordan: support dashboard shows spike in 5xxs and queued request timeouts for hosted customers on eu region starting 09:42 UTC. Top affected tenants: acme-ai (critical), med-vision (degraded). Incidents page updated.
Marta: patch plan — short term: throttle non-critical background jobs + enable fallback routing to eu-west-1 for critical traffic; medium: request quota bump with cloud and prepare pool reprovision; long: add cross-region warm pool. Thoughts?
Devon: agree. I can flip the priority-based admission plugin to evict batch slots. Command:
```
# switch to strict-priority admissions
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: admission-config
data:
  priorityMode: "strict"
EOF
```
Devon: this will free ~60 GPUs (evicts low-priority), but will cause some retries for batch jobs.
Li: we can also enable temporary 'burst-capacity' toggle in the infra control plane which allows using ondemand fallback instances in the shared pool. Risk: higher cost.
Marta: do it. Enable burst-capacity and evict batches. Devon, make sure low-priority eviction targets only non-hosted customers.
Devon: on it — running eviction now.
deploy-bot: deployment started: admission-config update to infra-controlplane succeeded (rev 74c2).
Devon: eviction reports ~52 GPUs freed, queue dropped by ~40% in 5m. Autoscaler still showing pending creates failing with 403.
Li: I called cloud support and opened ticket INC-98321; they confirm we've hit the per-project GPU hard limit in that GCP org and approval is required for increase. ETA unknown (initial response 45m).
Marta: need customer comms for acme-ai and med-vision. Katie, can you draft a quick note about degraded service + mitigation steps/ETA?
Katie: Drafting now. Will note: degraded for eu-central, failing over for critical workloads to eu-west, and cost-aware burst enabled. Asking for permission to route traffic if customers approve.
Jordan: pushed support notices to affected tenants and added temporary rate-limiting to keep control-plane stable.
Marta: fallback routing: Devon, can you spin up eu-west-1 warm nodes and ensure model variants are compatible? We should not route until warm pool has KV caches warmed.
Devon: starting warm pool build. Pulling model cache snapshot to eu-west-1. This may take 12-18m. Will stage a canary customer first (acme-ai after they opt in).
Li: note — quota bump may take hours. Recommend preparing longer-lived mitigations: permanent cross-region warm pools + quota monitoring alerts.
Marta: logging a post-incident action: add automatic failover policy that can transparently route to alternate regions with cache prewarming and customer opt-in flags.
Devon: also adding metric for 'allocation_waitlist_seconds' so we can alert earlier.
infra-alert-bot: pagerduty: incident P2 created and paged oncall (Marta) at 09:53 UTC.
Marta: acked pager. We'll keep this thread as the coordination channel. If cloud support gives bump, we'll update here and reverse temporary changes.
Li: cloud support responded: they can grant a temporary quota for 48h if we provide justification and contact email for org admin. They'll expedite if we have committed capacity invoice. Opening request now.
Marta: Jordan/Katie loop in account billing and get the DM contact. Also prepare an opt-in form for customers to accept failover.
Jordan: billing contact pinged, awaiting reply.
Katie: sent customer opt-in message to acme-ai PM and med-vision ops. acme responded: accept failover. med-vision requests longer ETA, wants to stay in region.
Devon: started routing rules for acme-ai -> eu-west-1 canary now. Traffic shifted 10% and looks healthy. KV cache hit rate low but acceptable.
Marta: monitoring - error rate for acme dropped, overall queue decreasing. Still see some queued low-priority tasks. Keep evictions enabled until quota bump or warm pool scales.
Li: cloud support updated: temporary quota increase approved for 24h pending formal request by org admin. They need confirmation email within 2 hours.
Marta: Jordan, confirm we have email from billing and send.
Jordan: sent email to cloud support with org admin details at 10:28 UTC.
infra-alert-bot: note: autoscaler retry backoff cleared. New node creates are succeeding.
Devon: node creates successful. Pool capacity ramping; queue back to normal over next 7m.
Marta: great. Closing initial mitigation. Actions: 1) follow up with cloud to convert temp quota to permanent; 2) implement cross-region warm pools; 3) add allocation_waitlist_seconds alert; 4) review batching/rerun throttles. I'll open follow-up tickets.
Katie: I'll draft customer postmortem note for acme and med-vision.
Jordan: updating incident status to 'mitigated' and closing page.
Marta: thanks all. If anything changes reopen. :slightly_smiling_face:
